---
title: "US Fed Shows the RBA is Not About to ‘Run out of Ammunition’"
date: "2019-06-06"
categories: ["Monetary Policy"]
---

I have a piece in the USSC’s [45th](https://www.ussc.edu.au/analysis/us-fed-shows-rba-is-not-about-to-run-out-of-ammunition) on how the Federal Reserve shows that the RBA cannot ‘run out of ammunition’ and why the RBA is singularly responsible for managing aggregate demand.
